sources.title: Local nature recovery strategies: areas and responsible authorities
sources.verified_claim: DEFRA's current LNRS map/list identifies 48 strategy areas and publication updates, including Greater London; area status is strategic context, not a parcel habitat designation.

sources.title: Local nature recovery strategies: responsible authorities
sources.verified_claim: The responsible-authority list identifies Greater London as LNRS area 39 and provides the official authority mapping; it does not itself identify candidate-level habitat actions.

sources.title: Local nature recovery strategies
sources.verified_claim: LNRSs must contain a local habitat map and biodiversity-priorities statement and propose locations for nature-recovery actions; exact mapped overlap is required before candidate use.

sources.title: Natural environment planning practice guidance
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: Planning practice guidance states LPAs must have regard to relevant LNRSs and describes their spatial role; having regard to a strategy is not equivalent to a parcel-specific designation.

sources.title: Biodiversity net gain
sources.verified_claim: The BNG collection links current developer, land-manager, LPA, metric, legal-agreement, monitoring and register guidance; requirements must be evaluated against the specific development.

sources.title: Biodiversity net gain: what local planning authorities should do
sources.verified_claim: Current LPA guidance requires checking application-specific biodiversity information and notes a future 6 August 2026 exemption change for developments at or below 0.2 hectares; the future rule is not applied before its effective date.

sources.title: Register a biodiversity gain site
sources.verified_claim: Off-site biodiversity gains must be registered with required land and legal information; registration is evidence about the gain site, not proof of allocation to a candidate development.

sources.title: Search the biodiversity gain sites register
sources.verified_claim: The national register exposes gain-site location, boundaries, habitats and allocations; exact candidate scoring requires a verified allocation/relationship rather than mere proximity.
